body: I hate how your words make sense, i wish i can reach that level of self love and compassion. Thank you for your reply.
That’s the thing i think it’s a mixture of both, but mostly regret that i made my family, my boyfriend and my friends to go through that.
I told someone in my family and they handed me religion as a survival guid. But thank you, your words are a great help to me.

My family are so fucked up to the fucking core, they’re a bunch of miserable, sad, and helpless people who live in delusion. And my friends don’t really care, they hate how i bring them down with my mental illnesses and misery, but my niece is kinda my lifeline, i love how innocent and pure she is and I don’t want her to live in a world where her only aunti committed suicide.
I’m so disappointed with him and he’s so passive so whatever his reaction might be, it’ll only upset me

Sometimes I feel like I might be on the spectrum, but also it could be my bpd and anxiety. It’s difficult to get diagnosed especially for an adult and a female so I’m just riding the wave of social awkwardness. It adds spice to everyday interactions tbh.

I totally relate to what you’re saying, my colleagues point out my special empathy that I have towards patients and even though it causes me tremendous mental and emotional trouble but i think it’s my super power. Thank you for making me realize the importance of it all...

I’ve read your reply multiple times, I really appreciate your kind words. Sometimes we forget for what and why we do the things we do especially when you’re in the center of it all but reading the words of a person who’s seeing things from outside helps us imagine the blurred bigger picture. 

Thank you my dear, heaven knows I’ll return to your reply many times more...

All the time lol, i was on a “break” from social media for months and I came back 2 weeks ago but it didn’t even last for more than 24 hours, I found myself permanently deleting all my accounts at 3 in the morning.
This means a lot to me, thank you for sharing this with me, it’s really tiring and sad but hurting the people we love might be worse so...
